sources.title: Inside the Chip: Powering the Future of Advanced Packaging

watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「封裝射頻遮蔽」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Package RF shielding. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「定義干擾源和受害者」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Define source and victim requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「辨識接縫洩漏」列為查證任務：觀察焦點：比較等面積小孔與長縫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Identify seam leakage: Observation focus: Compare a compact opening with a long slot of equal area. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

courses.overview: 相似工法的重點是可轉移的物理與證據；下列比較保留各自不同的材料和模型邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Related methods share transferable physics and evidence while retaining distinct materials and model boundaries.

related.title: 封裝訊號完整性設計
related.why: 完整回流同時改善 SI 與 EMI
related.whyEn: Continuous returns improve both SI and EMI
related.transfer: 完整回流同時改善 SI 與 EMI
related.transferEn: Continuous returns improve both SI and EMI
related.difference: 封裝屏蔽是場耦合處理，非眼圖保證
related.differenceEn: Shielding addresses field coupling rather than guaranteeing eyes
practice: 畫出「封裝射頻遮蔽」與「封裝訊號完整性設計」的材料、能量或資料交接。
以「定義干擾源和受害者」為比較起點，指出兩課共享的守恆或量測原理。
提出一個會使「完整回流同時改善 SI 與 EMI」失效的邊界條件，並安排驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the material, energy or data handoff between Package RF shielding and Package signal-integrity design.
Use define source and victim to identify a shared conservation or measurement principle.
State and test one boundary that would invalidate this transfer: Continuous returns improve both SI and EMI

courses.summary: 本課以RF 屏蔽導電連續性、孔縫與近場耦合連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through rf shield continuity, apertures and near-field coupling. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.

history.title: 合作研究中心在魯汶成立
history.titleEn: A collaborative research center starts in Leuven
history.text: imec 官方歷史記錄其成立背景；共同研究模式使材料、元件和系統問題能在同一研究環境連結。
history.textEn: Imec’s official history records its establishment; collaborative research connects materials, devices and systems in one research environment.

history.title: 微流體散熱連結晶片與系統
history.titleEn: Microfluidic cooling connects chips and systems
history.text: imec 公開介紹矽微流道研究，說明晶片性能需與散熱及封裝一起思考；此為研究展示，不是所有課程的量產規格。
history.textEn: Imec publicly described silicon microchannel research, illustrating the need to consider chip performance together with cooling and packaging. This is a research demonstration, not a production specification for every course.

courses.connection: 將地圖視為研究交流的定位點，再依每個來源了解不同機構在材料、設備、量測與系統驗證上的分工。
courses.connectionEn: Use the map as a research reference, then trace each source’s role in materials, equipment, metrology and system validation.
